summary: Jerash Holdings filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting held September 10, 2026, and furnishing a press release the next day. Stockholders elected five directors — Ng Tsze Lun, Wei (Kitty) Yang, Ibrahim H. Saif, Bill Korn, and Mak Chi Yan — each serving until the 2027 annual meeting, with roughly 7.7–7.9 million votes for and modest withheld totals. A non-binding advisory proposal on named executive officer compensation passed with 7,845,655 votes for, 71,342 against, and 2,897 abstentions. No broker non-votes were reported. No special-situation transaction, stake, or deal terms are disclosed; this is a routine meeting-result filing.
